notes: New check: tells you if your router, camera or storage box is a model the FBI says criminals are hijacking, or one with a flaw CISA says is being used in attacks right now. Paid plans get a same-day alert when their model is added.
New check: tells you when Chrome, Edge or Firefox on this PC is two or more versions behind - the usual sign it has stopped updating itself.
Fixed: opening Wrenscan again while its window was minimized showed a blank white window. It now brings the dashboard back.
The window now fits the screen on smaller laptops instead of hanging off the bottom.
One-click fixes: a fix that can't be applied now says why in plain words; 'Turn on real-time protection' and the Quad9 DNS fix no longer say they failed when they worked.
Uninstalling Wrenscan now removes its scheduled scans from Windows too.
Settings > Theme now changes the dashboard as well as reports.
Smaller fixes: the 'wrenscan checks' command, licence status now shows a running trial, and a clearer note where the list of software flaws isn't needed.
